quest.title: Cave Letter
quest.description: A mysterious letter found inside a cave.

node.journal_entry: "Oh those memories from the lighthouse! Second only to the one I have from this place. I'll never forget that night. You know after we saw the ritual. It was wonderful. That was the night I conceived him. Our little boy.Oh there is so much I had to tell you but didn't when I had the time. You knew from the day you met me that I wasn't just another mercian girl. You knew that. I need you to gather some items from the area surrounding the outpost where I told my father about us. It is the one he build before invading your lands... and I think unintentionally I played a part in that... Please be careful. I believe the small fort east of the outpost is now occupied by hobgoblins. Oh and please stay away from the lake. I heard that Matayins lurk in the waters. Pass by the temple ruins northeast from the outpost. I need you to trap one of the wisps that dwell there. You'll need it. You will find my next letter at the top of the mountain that oversees your capital city. Bring the wisp and the present I gave you on our third moon anniversary. Yes, the blood vial that I told you it will protect you in dark times. Bring an empty bottle too."
